explicit_bwrap_permission_error.proven: Explicit Linux bubblewrap permission error in final failing output, including every one of48 exec-server failures.
explicit_bwrap_permission_error.notProven: Underlying runner policy or host kernel setting responsible; not an Android direct-runner execution.
explicit_bwrap_permission_error.impact: Blocks these Linux sandbox tests. Does not demonstrate a missing bwrap prerequisite for the separate r21 ordinary UID executor.

stack_overflow.proven: 35 TUI test processes really overflowed their stack and aborted under RUST_MIN_STACK=8388608.
stack_overflow.notProven: Root code/recursion/frame cause or whether a larger test stack suffices; no such rerun occurred.
stack_overflow.impact: Real crash failures, not cosmetic. No observed Android crash can be inferred from these Linux TUI fixtures.

snapshot_difference.notProven: A correction passing all render cases; snapshots not updated.

tls_assertion.notProven: Environment-only explanation or all real HTTP behavior defective.
